## Quantified Production Highlights
- Sub-50ms Synchronous POS Fraud Engine: Built from scratch in Golang utilizing the Strategy Pattern to detect cashier collusion and rolling-window velocity anomalies with cross-timezone normalization[cite: 2, 11].
- 100% OLTP/OLAP Decoupling: Integrated native `gosnowflake` drivers into Go microservices, streaming and aggregating millions of transactional events into merchant dashboards without database read locks[cite: 2, 11].
- 4.8x Cryptographic Hashing Throughput: Accelerated SHA-256 computation over high-volume data streams implementing low-level SIMD AVX2 vector instructions in Assembly/Go[cite: 2, 11].
- Zero-Polling Kernel File Observability: Intercepted Linux kernel inodes (`inotify`) to trigger real-time cryptographic state notarizations with zero user-space CPU polling overhead[cite: 2, 11].
- Enterprise Security & Compliance Automation: Automated access governance and secret detection across 10+ core repositories correlating BigQuery telemetry, internal APIs, and pre-commit hooks under SOC 2 / Vanta standards[cite: 2, 11].
